statement.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
statement.summary: The Fed held the federal funds rate at 3.75%-4% by a 10-2 vote. It said inflation remains elevated, more information will guide the appropriate stance, and the Committee will deliver price stability. Two members wanted a quarter-point hike.
statement.quote: The accumulation of more information will help the Committee determine the policy stance appropriate to ensure a timely return of inflation to the Committee's 2 percent goal.
statement.vote: 10-2; Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack preferred to raise the target range by 1/4 percentage point

statement.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
statement.summary: BoE held Bank Rate at 3.75% (6-3 vote), citing energy-driven inflation risks tilted to the upside; stands ready to act if needed. Also voted to unwind QE to zero via gilt sales through 2034.
statement.quote: The Committee stands ready to act as necessary to ensure that CPI inflation remains on track to meet the 2% target in the medium term.
statement.vote: 6-3; three members preferred a 25bp increase to 4%

statement.title: Bank of Canada raises the policy rate by 25 basis points to 2½%

statement.title: Statement by the Monetary Policy Board: Monetary Policy Decision

statement.title: Statement on Monetary Policy
statement.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its overnight call rate target at around 1.25 percent, with one member wanting 1.5 percent. It also raised its annual ETF sales pace to about 860 billion yen from 330 billion, starting January 2027.
statement.quote: The Bank will encourage the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.25 percent.
